definition: A skin is a complete visual grammar, not a palette. It must change composition, shape language, type hierarchy, surfaces, data presentation, navigation, media treatment, component recipes and motion while preserving component behavior.

dimensions.label: Page/shell composition
dimensions.description: Page shell, grid, asymmetry, grouping, panel rhythm and navigation composition

dimensions.label: Geometry/shape language
dimensions.description: Corners, frame forms, outline weight, dividers and silhouette

dimensions.label: Type hierarchy
dimensions.description: Display treatment, scale, family direction, tabular/data typography and hierarchy

dimensions.label: Data and navigation patterns
dimensions.description: How users move and how tables, metrics, lists and data are composed

dimensions.label: Image/texture treatment
dimensions.description: Original illustration, collage, screentone, signal, brush, or deliberate absence

dimensions.label: Component visual recipes
dimensions.description: Cards, buttons, inputs, tables, badges and overlays visual constructions

dimensions.label: Motion signature
dimensions.description: Transition character and interaction emphasis, with reduced-motion fallback

acceptance.scoring: For each pair, score each dimension 0=no material difference, 1=some difference, 2=strong difference. Require >=4 dimensions scored 2 or clearly documented as materially distinct; total score is supporting evidence, not an automatic pass.

antiOverlapRules: Moonpunk != Moonriot recolored; distinguish block/offset construction from angular riot-editorial disruption.
Moonzine != Moonhalftone; distinguish editorial collage/paper grammar from manga raster/ink grammar.
Moonhalftone != Moonpanel; distinguish raster and pacing from rigid modular panel grid.
Moonink != Moonscrawl; distinguish expressive brush illustration from sketchbook annotation.
Moonglitch != Moonchrome; distinguish telemetry/signal disturbance from metallic material response.
Mooncrash != Moonledger; distinguish industrial hazard/operational plates from clean enterprise data workbench.
Moonraw != Classic; distinguish exposed raw structure from polished conventional baseline.
Moonsmash != Moonpunk; distinguish explosive focal/radial impact from persistent hard-slab layout.
Moonquest's game motifs must not leak into core primitives or Moonledger.
Shared colors or fonts are allowed; shared visual grammar must be reviewed and justified.

skins.name: Moonpunk
skins.composition: asymmetric block composition; strong framed zones; offset utility rail
skins.geometry: thick black outlines; square-to-cut corners; hard offset shadows
skins.type: condensed loud display + highly legible neutral body
skins.surface: ink-dark planes; exposed borders; controlled grain
skins.navigation: command rail with high-contrast active slab
skins.data: bold stat slabs; simplified charts with sharp markers
skins.media: original manga ink, torn-paper edges, halftone used sparingly
skins.motion: snappy 100–180ms; short impact settle; reduced-motion removes overshoot
skins.antiOverlap: must not become Moonriot recolored red or Moonsmash with lime

skins.name: Moonriot
skins.composition: diagonal split panels; intentionally disrupted editorial columns
skins.geometry: sharp cuts; slanted section dividers; asymmetric border breaks
skins.type: compressed editorial display + disciplined technical body
skins.surface: black fields; signal-red annotations; limited scan distortion
skins.navigation: split navigation with angular section markers
skins.data: signal strips and segmented metrics; labels remain steady and readable
skins.media: riot posters, signal marks, abstract original cut-up forms
skins.motion: short directional wipes; glitch only as optional nonessential accent
skins.antiOverlap: must not use Moonpunk's hard-slab composition or Moonzine's paper collage grammar

skins.name: Moonzine
skins.composition: magazine spread; editorial asymmetry; collage-like grouping
skins.geometry: paper frames; taped/overlapped labels as decoration, not layout control
skins.type: editorial serif or expressive display paired with neutral body
skins.surface: paper-like light surfaces and photocopy dark surfaces
skins.navigation: index/contents navigation with editorial section labels
skins.data: report cards and story summaries; visible source/annotation areas
skins.media: original collage, cut paper, xerox grain and editorial crops
skins.motion: page-like reveals and gentle layering; reduced motion becomes static
skins.antiOverlap: must not collapse into strict comic panels (Moonpanel) or monochrome screentone-only (Moonhalftone)

skins.name: Moonhalftone
skins.composition: sequential comic pacing; variable panel density; ink-first hierarchy
skins.geometry: panel borders; halftone fields; high-contrast gutters
skins.type: manga impact headings + neutral reading text
skins.surface: monochrome ink/paper; dot texture used in reserved zones
skins.navigation: panel index and clear chapter/section progression
skins.data: panelized stories, annotated metrics, clear chart equivalents
skins.media: original screentone patterns and abstract ink assets
skins.motion: panel reveal and restrained directional transition
skins.antiOverlap: must not use Moonpanel's rigid uniform grid as its entire identity

skins.name: Moonglitch
skins.composition: telemetry rails; console bands; data-centric dashboard zones
skins.geometry: thin technical rules; signal bars; occasional deliberate displacement
skins.surface: near-black terminal surfaces with scanline and signal accents
skins.data: live event stream, logs, time-series and compact telemetry
skins.media: original abstract signal traces; glitch never obscures text
skins.motion: signal transitions; no perpetual flashing; reduced motion disables distortion
skins.antiOverlap: must remain functional telemetry, not decorative cyberpunk or neon-only styling

skins.name: Moonsmash
skins.composition: one dominant focal zone; radial grouping; dramatic scale changes
skins.geometry: burst outlines; radial marks; bold oversized planes
skins.type: oversized expressive display + concise supportive copy
skins.surface: high-impact layered panels with clear quiet areas for data
skins.navigation: action-first navigation and strong primary focal route
skins.data: milestone meters and high-visibility stats; detail views remain calm
skins.media: original abstract burst, speed lines and impact forms
skins.motion: brief radial or scale response with reduced-motion static replacement
skins.antiOverlap: must not share Moonpunk's persistent slab framing or Moonriot's diagonal signal language

skins.name: Moonink
skins.composition: organic directional flow around a clear reading column
skins.geometry: brush-edged decorative separators; functional controls remain precise
skins.type: ink-like display accents + calm readable body
skins.surface: paper/ink planes, expressive strokes confined to decoration
skins.navigation: illustrated section markers and simple linear navigation
skins.data: annotated narrative charts and editorial callouts
skins.media: original vector brush strokes and ink wash assets
skins.motion: stroke-draw accents are optional; never required to understand state
skins.antiOverlap: must not become sketchbook notes (Moonscrawl) or monochrome raster texture (Moonhalftone)

skins.name: Mooncrash
skins.composition: stacked work zones; plate-like panels; clear functional grouping
skins.geometry: mechanical borders; numbered plates; warning stripes only for actual emphasis
skins.surface: matte metal-inspired surfaces; restrained hazard highlights
skins.data: resource gauges, logs and operational status blocks
skins.media: original industrial motifs and abstract technical markings
skins.motion: mechanical slide/click feedback; no decorative shaking on errors
skins.antiOverlap: must not use Moonchrome's reflective material or Moonglitch's terminal telemetry treatment

skins.name: Moonpanel
skins.composition: explicit grid; consistent gutters; panel hierarchy controls page rhythm
skins.geometry: rectangular frames; varied panel spans; clear panel titles
skins.type: comic chapter heads + strong, consistent body hierarchy
skins.surface: clearly bounded panels and contrasting gutters
skins.navigation: panel map/index and predictable section grid
skins.data: modular visual summaries and panels with consistent data placement
skins.media: original panel motifs; illustrative content stays inside bounded frames
skins.motion: panel focus/slide transitions; consistent grid continuity
skins.antiOverlap: must not become Moonhalftone with different colors; its identity is structural grid and panel span

skins.name: Moonscrawl
skins.composition: canvas with margin notes and exploratory clusters
skins.geometry: loose hand-drawn annotation around precise functional controls
skins.type: hand-lettered labels used sparingly + readable body
skins.surface: draft-paper and sketch marks with low visual interference
skins.navigation: notebook tabs, margin index or workspace sections
skins.data: annotated diagrams, brainstorm maps and exploratory flows
skins.media: original sketches, arrows, circles and handwritten callouts
skins.motion: draw-on annotations optional; static fallback is complete
skins.antiOverlap: must remain intentional and structured, not Moonzine collage or Moonink brush painting

skins.name: Moonraw
skins.composition: rigid clear page frame; low ornament; content-led blocks
skins.geometry: plain rectangles, exposed separators, square edges
skins.type: direct heavy headings + neutral body; no decorative display by default
skins.surface: flat materials; nearly no gradients or shadows
skins.data: plain dense tables and direct metrics with minimal framing
skins.media: typography and structure dominate; textures mostly absent
skins.antiOverlap: must not borrow Moonledger's enterprise-specific compact workbench or Classic's polished neutral finish

skins.name: Moonchrome
skins.composition: layered focal surface with precise contour accents
skins.geometry: thin metallic contours and controlled bevel cues
skins.surface: reflective metallic gradient cues and restrained spectral highlights
skins.navigation: layered surface navigation with clear selected state
skins.data: precision gauges, orbital metrics and crisp visualizations
skins.media: original abstract chrome, orbit and spectral forms
skins.motion: light-shift/reflection effects only on demand; reduced motion uses static materials
skins.antiOverlap: must not become generic glassmorphism or Mooncrash industrial plating

skins.name: Classic
skins.composition: conventional app shell; predictable content hierarchy
skins.geometry: standard rounded controls; subtle borders and restrained elevation
skins.type: neutral modern sans with conventional heading scale
skins.data: familiar tables, forms and cards with conservative styling
skins.media: no skin-specific illustration requirement; functional icon defaults
skins.motion: restrained conventional transition; respect reduced motion
skins.antiOverlap: must be documented as Moonframe's compatibility baseline, not official shadcn branding

skins.name: Moonquest
skins.composition: quest journal, inventory and status HUD; clear game-oriented zones
skins.geometry: framed panels, rarity treatments, map/journal motifs
skins.type: adventure display headings + highly readable body/data
skins.surface: fantasy/sci-fi material layers without reducing text contrast
skins.navigation: journal / inventory / map / progression navigation patterns
skins.data: XP/progression, rarity, quest lists and item slots as presentation only
skins.media: original game-inspired symbols, map textures and item-frame assets
skins.motion: reward/level-up accents are opt-in; reduced motion keeps progress information
skins.antiOverlap: must not place game rules, rewards, inventory persistence or scoring logic in the UI package

skins.name: Moonledger
skins.territory: professional ERP / clean compact data workbench
skins.composition: dense workspace; persistent filter area; table/detail split panes
skins.geometry: precise aligned grids; restrained radius; subtle separators
skins.type: high-legibility enterprise sans with tabular numerals
skins.surface: neutral surfaces and muted chrome; strong data hierarchy
skins.navigation: persistent workspace navigation, breadcrumbs and contextual actions
skins.data: dense but readable tables, filters, saved views and audit timelines
skins.media: minimal; charts/tables carry the interface, decorative art is excluded
skins.motion: subtle transitions; prioritize feedback latency and stability
skins.antiOverlap: must not shrink controls below tested target requirements or inherit Moonquest's game treatment

exceptionPolicy: Any failed pair requires a visual revision or a documented exception with owner, rationale, and revisit date. No pair is considered passed by default.
